what: Click the left half of the photo panel for the previous slide, the right half for the next — the new slide unfolds from the clicked-side edge with a clip-path polygon in .75s power1.out while sliding in from 50% of the panel width to its place in .75s power2.out (wraps back to the first slide at the end). The page number fades out in .25s and fades back in with the new number in .25s, and if a sub panel exists, the image with the same slide number follows along the same way. The cursor position follows with a .25s lag via --x·--y, so the Prev·Next label of the hovered half sticks at cursor height. Swiping sideways with a finger also advances.

options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel (where the pressable half, number and text sit, optional — if absent, the element itself)
options.[data-fx-part=slides] > [data-fx-part=sl: Stacked sections and the visual that unfolds inside them
options.[data-fx-part=sub-slides] > [data-fx-par: Side panel (optional) — sections with the same number change along the same path
options.[data-fx-part=prev] · [data-fx-part=next: Panel left and right half buttons, inside them [data-fx-part=label](Prev·Next text)
options.shift: Side distance the entering section starts from, default 50%
options.count: Duration the number turns off and on (seconds), default .25
options.--fx-pad · --fx-next-top: Distance of the text from the panel edge (default 20px) · height the next text yields from above (number size, default 0)
options.fx:next · fx:prev: Fire this event on the element to advance it
